## "metadata_updated_by"

**Data type:**  
String  

**Value:**  
Username (both service users and human users) or null.

**Description of metadata field:**  
User that last updated the metadata of an asset. This is the user from keycloak which could include a service user.Updating means adding or changing a value of one the fields in the metadata. If no updates have been made this will be "null". 

**Populated by whom and when:**  
Populated by ARS the first time an asset has its metadata updated.

**Updated where and when:**  
In ARS when metadata is updated.

**Generated by:**  
ARS

**Maps to in ARS:**  
"metadata_update_by" and the event user in UPDATE_ASSET_METADATA event.

**Maps to in Specify:**  
None

**Notes and issues:**  
None
